content: Do not cast gold coins before a wandering cat.
author: Japanese Proverbs
explanation: A cat has no use for minted gold; it wants fish. Offering sacred insights, vulnerable confessions, or precious wisdom to those who seek only superficial entertainment is an injustice to both parties. Match your gifts to the vessel capable of holding them.
practicalInsight: Before sharing your deepest dreams or philosophical convictions, discern whether the listener is ready to receive them with reverence.
reflectionPrompt: Where have you been exhausting yourself trying to convince someone who lacks the appetite to understand?
